    SELECT AVG(score) as avg_score
    FROM avis
    WHERE score IS NOT NULL
),
utilisateurs_sup_moyenne AS (
    SELECT pseudo, score
    FROM avis a1
    CROSS JOIN moyenne_globale mg
    WHERE a1.score > mg.avg_score AND a1.score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT pseudo, score
FROM utilisateurs_sup_moyenne
ORDER BY pseudo ASC

results.question: Trouver les paires d'auteurs (dessinateur et scénariste) ayant réalisé plus d'un album ensemble.
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT p1.nom, p2.nom FROM ouvrage o JOIN personne p1 ON o.dessinateur = p1.idp JOIN personne p2 ON o.scenariste = p2.idp GROUP BY p1.idp, p1.nom, p2.idp, p2.nom HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY p1.nom;
results.generated_sql:
WITH auteurs_paires AS (
    SELECT 
        o.dessinateur AS id_dessin,
        o.scenariste AS id_scenario,
        COUNT(*) as nb_albums
    FROM ouvrage o
    WHERE o.dessinateur != o.scenariste  -- Pairs de personnes différentes uniquement
    GROUP BY o.dessinateur, o.scenariste
)
SELECT 
    p.nom AS dessinateur,
    s.nom AS scenariste,
    ap.nb_albums
FROM auteurs_paires ap
INNER JOIN personne p ON p.idp = ap.id_dessin
INNER JOIN personne s ON s.idp = ap.id_scenario
WHERE ap.nb_albums > 1
ORDER BY ap.nb_albums DESC, p.nom ASC

results.question: Calculer la note moyenne par série et classer les séries de la mieux notée à la moins bien notée.
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.titre, AVG(a.score) FROM serie s JOIN ouvrage o ON s.ids = o.ids JOIN avis a ON o.ido = a.ido GROUP BY s.ids, s.titre ORDER BY AVG(a.score) DESC;
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    s.titre AS serie_titre,
    AVG(a.score) as moyenne_score
FROM serie s
LEFT JOIN ouvrage o ON s.ids = o.ids
LEFT JOIN avis a ON o.ido = a.ido AND a.score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.ids, s.titre
ORDER BY moyenne_score DESC

args.sql:
WITH serie_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id,
        s.titre,
        AVG(a.score) as moyenne_score
    FROM serie s
    LEFT JOIN ouvrage o ON s.ids = o.ids
    LEFT JOIN avis a ON o.ido = a.ido AND a.score IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.id, s.titre
),
ranked_series AS (
    SELECT 
        titre,
        moyenne_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY moyenne_score DESC) as rang
    FROM serie_scores
)
SELECT titre, moyenne_score
FROM ranked_series;

WITH serie_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.ids,
        s.titre,
        AVG(a.score) as moyenne_score
    FROM serie s
    LEFT JOIN ouvrage o ON s.ids = o.ids
    LEFT JOIN avis a ON o.ido = a.ido AND a.score IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.ids, s.titre
),
ranked_series AS (
    SELECT 
        titre,
        moyenne_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY moyenne_score DESC) as rang
    FROM serie_scores
)
SELECT titre, moyenne_score
FROM ranked_series;

SELECT 
    s.titre AS serie_titre,
    AVG(a.score) as moyenne_score
FROM serie s
LEFT JOIN ouvrage o ON s.ids = o.ids
LEFT JOIN avis a ON o.ido = a.ido AND a.score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.ids, s.titre
ORDER BY moyenne_score DESC;
